test_executor_submit_no_args: test the Executor by submitting a no-argument function and asserting the returned result
test_executor_submit_with_args: test the Executor by submitting a function with positional and keyword arguments
test_executor_types: test the Executor across local, debug, and slurm executor types using a parametrized fixture
check_submitit_installed: check whether the submitit library is installed and importable in the current environment
yield_executor_types: yield available executor type strings including local, debug, and optionally slurm
